editorial.blurb: CM Korean Fried Chicken delivers crispy, juicy wings in bold flavors—from fiery spicy to sweet and savory—with genuinely warm service in a clean, quiet corner spot.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Sweet Korean fried chicken wings with sauce on the side so you can control how much of the coating you get, and ask about the mysterious Snow Onion Chicken sauce before ordering—reviewers are still debating if it's gravy, wasabi, or cheese.
